=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml, .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:114-249; 215-229; 3204-3218 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Serena contract tests added or expanded by this PR are absent from the explicit workflow allowlists, so CI never runs them.
  WHY: Every reviewer who checked reported the explicit `python3 tests/...` allowlists omit the Serena test files; severity is elevated to critical because multiple reviewers called it critical.
- agents.md:109-123 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Stable log prefixes section omits the Serena contractual prefixes required by the integration plan.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently noted `SERENA_QUERY` and `SERENA_PROBE` are missing there, and several also noted `SERENA_FALLBACK` is missing from the documented contract.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2172-2188 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The preexisting Serena project check uses the bare `.serena` directory instead of `.serena/project.yml`, so stale directories set `SERENA_PROJECT_PREEXISTED=true`.
  WHY: This disagrees with the file-level bootstrap/runtime-noise guards elsewhere; reviewers described it as a mismatch/code smell rather than a higher-severity runtime bug.
- scripts/serena_stats_emit.py, scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py, scripts/setup_serena.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:full scan of all changed files | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `SERENA_FALLBACK` is documented but never emitted anywhere in the codebase.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers grepped the changed files/codebase and found zero `SERENA_FALLBACK` occurrences, so fallback telemetry is missing.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:527-536 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `IFS='=' read -r env_key env_value` can truncate future `GITHUB_ENV` values containing `=`.
  WHY: The parser is only safe for the current env values and is fragile for future extensions.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:35-77 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The placeholder guard only catches standalone `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` lines, so inline placeholders can leak into rendered prompts.
  WHY: The check runs after rendering and the regex does not cover embedded occurrences.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1120-1140 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The runtime-noise filter pattern may not consistently match the root `.serena` directory entry.
  WHY: Bootstrap-owned `.serena/` changes can still appear in baseline diffs if the root entry format is not matched.
- scripts/setup_serena.sh:140-301 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `uv tool install --force` does not guarantee cache invalidation, so a corrupted Serena install may persist across runs.
  WHY: Reviewers said a bad cached install could leave bootstrap apparently successful while MCP probing fails downstream.
- scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py:250-280 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup path waits on the child process after terminate without first checking whether it already exited.
  WHY: That adds unnecessary latency on fast-exiting servers; one reviewer framed it as a 1s delay.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:193-330 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The exact-conflict dedup logic skips resolution when any occurrence lacks `captured_at`.
  WHY: Mixed legacy/timestamped entries can avoid the normal dedup path instead of being reconciled.
- tests/test_mcp_handshake_probe.py:main function | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: There is no test coverage for `--timeout=0` behavior.
  WHY: The operator override path could regress without exercising the clamp-to-default branch.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml`, `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` | severity=HIGH | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new Serena contract test files are not included in the CI workflow allowlists.
  WHY: Without CI coverage, regressions in Serena bootstrap, TOML emission, handshake probing, and stats parsing will go undetected.
- `agents.md` (lines 109-123) | severity=HIGH | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The stable log prefixes section is missing the required Serena prefixes (`SERENA_QUERY`, `SERENA_PROBE`, `SERENA_FALLBACK`).
  WHY: The workflow-log-analysis pipeline depends on documented log prefixes, and omitting these breaks the contractual observability interface.
- `scripts/validate_process.sh` (lines ~527-536) | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `IFS='=' read -r env_key env_value` loop will silently truncate any future GITHUB_ENV value containing `=`.
  WHY: This fragile parser could corrupt env values with embedded equals signs.
- `scripts/render_prompt.sh` (lines 35-73) | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Placeholder guards run after rendering, so unresolved placeholders embedded mid-sentence rather than on standalone lines can leak into prompts.
  WHY: The grep guard only catches `{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}` on a line by itself, not inline occurrences.
- `.github/workflows/implement.yml` (lines ~1120-1140) | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runtime-noise filter pattern `'*' .serena/'*|*' .serena'` may not consistently match the `.serena` root directory entry in git status output.
  WHY: Bootstrap-owned `.serena/` changes could still appear in baseline diffs if the pattern doesn't match the root entry format.
- `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (line ~2188) | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The preexisting-Serena detection checks `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- .serena` instead of `.serena/project.yml`.
  WHY: A stale/partial `.serena` directory without a project file could incorrectly set `PREEXISTED=true`, diverging from the file-level bootstrap guard used elsewhere.
- `scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py` (lines ~250-280) | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cleanup path calls `proc.wait(timeout=1.0)` after `terminate()` without checking if the process already exited.
  WHY: Unnecessary wait on fast-exiting servers adds latency to the probe failure path.
- `scripts/setup_serena.sh` | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `uv tool install --force` does not invalidate the cache, so a corrupted install can persist across runs.
  WHY: If uv reuses a bad cached tool, bootstrap appears successful while MCP probing fails downstream.
- `scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py` (lines ~193-330) | severity=MEDIUM | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The exact-conflict dedup logic assumes `captured_at` is always present. Entries missing timestamps skip the resolution path.
  WHY: Mixed legacy and timestamped entries can produce incorrect conflict handling.
- `scripts/serena_stats_emit.py`, `scripts/mcp_handshake_probe.py` | severity=LOW | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `SERENA_FALLBACK` is never emitted anywhere in the codebase.
  WHY: Without fallback telemetry, consumers cannot distinguish Serena unavailability from normal usage or measure fallback frequency.
- `tests/test_mcp_handshake_probe.py` (main function) | severity=LOW | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No test coverage for `--timeout=0` behavior (the operator override path for disabling the probe).
  WHY: The clamp-to-default behavior can regress without coverage.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
